surface: source-build run path / direct binary first protected action / config-credential discovery / activation CLI-API
spec_authority: docs/152e-edd-centered-universal-multi-surface-licensing-and-branded-facade-addendum.md §14.3 source and unofficial builds, §24.9 source builds and agents use the same flow; Specs 152, 150A, 152A-D; Spec 158 implementation excluded

environment.config_dir: $HOME/.config/focusa (fresh; may not exist before first run)
environment.installer_provenance: absent by definition: no installer receipt, no install root, no service unit, no PATH edits
environment.legacy_license_file: absent on a clean source build; if present it is a migration/verification input only and never a runtime grant
environment.authority_lease_file: absent until the universal activation flow issues a signed lease (authority-lease.json)

first_run_expected.protected_first_action: require_base_product -> LicenseError::BaseProductRequired until a signed lease exists; daemon gate -> ENTITLEMENT_BASE_REQUIRED
first_run_expected.activation: same universal authority flow as the installer: email -> verify -> offer -> checkout/poll -> signed lease; noninteractive -> device-code authorization; --agent -> typed human-action envelopes with a resumable registration handle
first_run_expected.terminal: activated (device-bound signed lease persisted at authority-lease.json)

deletion_matrix.delete: installer receipts / install root / service unit
deletion_matrix.effect: none - runtime entitlement is decided by the signed lease only

activation_cli_api.cli_agent: focusa license activate-flow --agent (noninteractive, never invents email/code/payment/license)

evidence_replay.rust_store_tests: cargo test -p focusa-license authority_store (first-run / delete-matrix / channel-neutral unit tests; exit 0)
evidence_replay.transcript_replay: crates/focusa-cli/src/commands/activation_flow.rs unit tests: paid terminal, existing key, limited-access overlay, recovery journeys through the shared ActivationSession
